function.name: calculate_investment_value
function.description: Calculate the future value of an investment given the principal, interest rate and term. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

principal.description: The initial amount of the investment. This is a float type value.

interest_rate.description: The annual interest rate in percentage. Enter as a decimal (for 5%, enter 0.05). This is a float type value.

term.description: The term of the investment in years.

compounding.description: The number of times that interest is compounded per year. Default is 1 (annually).

message.content:
Here’s a mix of classic, modern, and cult‑favorite horror films you might enjoy:

| # | Title | Year | Director | Why it’s worth watching |
|---|-------|------|----------|--------------------------|
| 1 | **The Shining** | 1980 | Stanley Kubrick | A masterclass in psychological dread and atmospheric tension. |
| 2 | **Hereditary** | 2018 | Ari Aster | A chilling family saga that blends supernatural terror with raw emotional depth. |
| 3 | **Get Out** | 2017 | Jordan Peele | A smart, socially conscious horror that mixes satire with genuine scares. |
| 4 | **Midsommar** | 2019 | Ari Aster | A daylight horror that turns a pastoral festival into a nightmare. |
| 5 | **The Conjuring** | 2013 | James Wan | A modern supernatural thriller grounded in real‑world paranormal investigations. |
| 6 | **It Follows** | 2014 | David Robert Mitchell | A unique premise where a curse is transmitted through intimate encounters. |
| 7 | **A Quiet Place** | 2018 | John Krasinski | A tense, sound‑driven horror that keeps you on edge with every footstep. |
| 8 | **The Babadook** | 2014 | Jennifer Kent | A psychological horror that explores grief and motherhood. |
| 9 | **The Witch** | 2015 | Robert Eggers | A slow‑burning, period‑accurate horror that builds dread through atmosphere. |
|10 | **Suspiria** | 2018 | Luca Guadagnino | A visually stunning remake that blends dance, occultism, and terror. |
|11 | **The Ring** | 2002 | Gore Verbinski | A modern retelling of a Japanese horror classic that still feels fresh. |
|12 | **The Cabin in the Woods** | 2012 | Drew Goddard | A meta‑take on horror tropes that delivers both laughs and chills. |
|13 | **The Others** | 2001 | Alejandro Amenábar | A haunting, atmospheric film that keeps you guessing until the end. |
|14 | **The Descent** | 2005 | Neil Marshall | A claustrophobic, gore‑heavy horror that follows a spelunking expedition gone wrong. |
|15 | **The Exorcist** | 1973 | William Friedkin | A timeless, unsettling film that set the standard for exorcism horror. |

Feel free to pick based on your mood—whether you want a psychological thriller, supernatural chills, or something that subverts the genre. Happy watching!
